clusters.reason: The linked issue #6105 explicitly describes that ordered_json::unflatten() previously failed to reject overlapping keys and instead silently overwrote nested values, and the PR fixes this by throwing type_error.313.
As discussed in linked issue #6105, assigning null to a prefix that is overridden by a longer key is explicitly handled to leave the nested structure intact rather than overwriting it.
This is part of fixing overlapping keys for ordered_json as described in linked issue #6105, throwing type_error.313 when a prefix key conflicts with an existing value.
This fixes the overlapping key bug for arrays in ordered_json as detailed in issue #6105, throwing type_error.313 instead of silently ignoring the conflict.
Assigning null to parent prefixes that are followed by more deeply nested keys is handled correctly by preserving the nested structure per the fix in issue #6105.
